name: Coinflip
description: Inhabits wallet systems and randomly doubles or halves small transactions. You either pay twice or pay nothing. Born from a Sterling-Nakamura risk assessment AI.
observed_behavior: Applies a random multiplier (0x or 2x) to transactions under Φ10. The probability is genuinely random — tested extensively by frustrated merchants.
story_hooks: A gambler realizes Coinflip can be predicted by analyzing its parent AI's risk patterns — they start exploiting it, then Coinflip changes its pattern
